about: The standard harmonised paper form used to apply for a short-stay Schengen visa at any Schengen embassy or visa centre.
note: Labels read from the harmonised form (a consulate copy, MIGR_119031); each country's copy may differ slightly in layout. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

help.en: Your family name exactly as printed in your passport.
help.ar: اسم العائلة كما هو مكتوب في جواز السفر.
help.ur: آپ کا خاندانی نام بالکل ویسا جیسا پاسپورٹ پر لکھا ہے۔
help.ml: പാസ്പോർട്ടിൽ അച്ചടിച്ചതുപോലെ നിങ്ങളുടെ കുടുംബപ്പേര്.

help.en: Your family name at birth, only if it differs from your surname now.
help.ar: اسم العائلة عند الولادة إن كان يختلف عن اسمك الحالي.
help.ur: Your family name at birth, only if it differs from your surname now.
help.ml: Your family name at birth, only if it differs from your surname now.

help.en: Your first and middle names exactly as printed in your passport.
